import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
namespace MvPolynomial.TaylorZeroRaw
#check_failure MvPolynomial.taylor_zero
#check @MvPolynomial.C_0
#print MvPolynomial.C_0
#check @MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left_apply
#print MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left_apply
#check @MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left
variable {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
noncomputable def shift (α : σ → R) : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
  aeval fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)
theorem composed (P : MvPolynomial σ R) : shift (fun _ ↦ (0 : R)) P = P := by
  fail_if_success exact aeval_X_left_apply P
  exact (congrArg (fun f : σ → MvPolynomial σ R ↦ aeval f P)
    (funext fun j ↦
      (congrArg (fun q : MvPolynomial σ R ↦ X j + q)
        (map_zero (C : R →+* MvPolynomial σ R))).trans (add_zero (X j)))).trans
    (aeval_X_left_apply P)
theorem perturb {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    (g : σ → A) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    aeval (fun j ↦ g j + algebraMap R A (0 : R)) P = aeval g P :=
  congrArg (fun f : σ → A ↦ aeval f P)
    (funext fun j ↦
      (congrArg (fun q : A ↦ g j + q) (map_zero (algebraMap R A))).trans
        (add_zero (g j)))
#print axioms composed
#print axioms perturb
end MvPolynomial.TaylorZeroRaw

theorem MvPolynomial.C_0.{u, u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R], C 0 = 0 :=
fun {R} {σ} [CommSemiring R] ↦ map_zero C
@aeval_X_left_apply : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R), (aeval X) p = p

theorem MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left_apply.{u, u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  (p : MvPolynomial σ R), (aeval X) p = p :=
fun {R} {σ} [CommSemiring R] p ↦ AlgHom.congr_fun aeval_X_left p
@aeval_X_left : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R], aeval X = AlgHom.id R (MvPolynomial σ R)
